summary: Iteration 15: Tested admin Edit/Delete journal entries (cashbook) + admin Unlock submitted expense sheets. All 23 backend tests pass. All frontend features verified for admin and muneem roles.

feature_tests.get_single_entry: PASS - GET /api/accounts/entries/{entry_id} returns 200 with all fields (id, date, narration, lines, entry_type, total_amount, illaka_id). Invalid ID → 400. Nonexistent → 404. Admin and Muneem both can fetch.
feature_tests.delete_entry_admin: PASS - DELETE /api/accounts/entries/{entry_id} returns 200 with message. Deleted entry returns 404 on subsequent GET. Invalid ID → 400. Nonexistent → 404.
feature_tests.update_entry_expense_voucher: PASS - PUT /api/accounts/entries/{entry_id} updates expense_voucher narration and amount. Changes persist on GET.
feature_tests.update_auto_generated_loan_disbursement_: PASS - PUT on loan_disbursement entry returns 400 'Auto-generated entries cannot be edited'.
feature_tests.update_auto_generated_emi_collection_400: PASS - PUT on emi_collection entry returns 400 'Auto-generated entries cannot be edited'.
feature_tests.update_sipahi_403: PASS - Sipahi gets 403 on PUT entry.
feature_tests.unlock_submission_admin: PASS - PATCH /api/accounts/expense-submissions/{sub_id}/unlock returns 200. Submission status reverts to 'draft', journal_entry_id set to null.
feature_tests.unlock_removes_journal_entry: PASS - Associated journal entry is deleted from DB after unlock (GET returns 404).
feature_tests.unlock_draft_400: PASS - Unlocking an already-draft submission returns 400 'not in submitted state'.
feature_tests.cashbook_edit_btn_on_expense_voucher: PASS - Admin sees pencil (edit) icon on expense_voucher type entries in cashbook. Edit button opens pre-filled 'Edit Entry' modal with correct date, amount, narration, account head.
feature_tests.cashbook_no_edit_btn_on_expense_sheet: PASS - Expense_sheet type entry shows only trash (delete) icon, NO edit button.
feature_tests.cashbook_delete_btn_on_all_types: PASS - Delete (trash) button appears on all entry types (expense_voucher, expense_sheet).
feature_tests.cashbook_edit_flow: PASS - Clicking edit button, updating narration/amount, clicking 'Update Entry' shows 'Entry updated' toast and reflects changes in cashbook.
feature_tests.cashbook_delete_flow: PASS - Clicking delete shows confirm dialog 'Delete this journal entry? This cannot be undone.', confirms deletion with 'Entry deleted' toast, entry removed from cashbook list.
feature_tests.expense_sheet_unlock_flow: PASS - Admin sees orange 'Unlock' button on submitted expense sheet. Clicking shows confirm dialog. After confirm: 'Entry updated' toast shown, sheet reverts to draft (Save Draft + Submit buttons appear, Unlock button disappears).
feature_tests.muneem_no_edit_delete_buttons: PASS - Muneem cashbook shows 0 edit buttons and 0 delete buttons (data-testid^='edit-entry-' and data-testid^='delete-entry-' not found).
feature_tests.muneem_no_unlock_button: PASS - Muneem Expense Sheet tab does NOT show Unlock button (data-testid='unlock-expense-btn' not found).
feature_tests.muneem_expense_form_accessible: PASS - Muneem can see Monthly Expense form with Save Draft and Submit buttons after admin unlock.

critical_code_review_comments: OK: GET /api/accounts/entries/{entry_id} does not filter by illaka/role - any authenticated user can fetch any entry by ID. This is acceptable for the current design (read-only access) but worth noting for future auditing.

OK: PUT /api/accounts/entries/{entry_id} uses SimpleEntryCreate body - illaka_id is required but the existing illaka_id is not validated against the user's accessible illakas for admin. Minor gap for Muneem (who can only edit current-month entries per freeze check).
OK: PATCH /unlock correctly sets journal_entry_id=None and status=draft, also records unlocked_by_id/name/at for audit trail.
OK: Frontend canAct check (user.role === 'admin' || user.role === 'maalik') correctly gates edit/delete buttons in CashBook component.
OK: handleEditEntry fetches entry by ID then extracts nonCashLine to pre-fill SimpleEntryModal - works correctly for expense_voucher type.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all features verified: cashbook edit+delete buttons, edit modal pre-fill, delete confirm, expense sheet unlock, muneem restrictions)
